tour.overview:
The American West holds some of the most spectacular landscapes on Earth. This private tour links the best of them: San Francisco and Yosemite in California, then, after a flight to Las Vegas, a loop through the canyon country of Arizona and Utah – the Grand Canyon, Horseshoe Bend, Antelope Canyon, Monument Valley and Zion.

You travel with private guides and vehicles, with a domestic flight, park fees, Navajo-guided tours and nine nights in well-located hotels, at a pace that leaves time for sunsets and sunrises at the great viewpoints.

AT A GLANCE
• Duration: 10 days, 9 nights
• Start: San Francisco airport or your hotel
• End: Las Vegas airport
• Type: private tour with guides, private vehicles and a domestic flight; 9 nights with breakfast
• Booking: on request – we confirm availability, hotels, flight and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay only then
• Level: easy to moderate

WHAT YOU SEE
• San Francisco and Alcatraz.
• Yosemite Valley.
• Las Vegas and the Hoover Dam.
• The Grand Canyon South Rim.
• Horseshoe Bend and Antelope Canyon.
• Monument Valley and Zion.

WHY THIS WORKS
The route avoids backtracking and keeps driving days reasonable, with nights placed at the canyons for the best light.

WHO IT SUITS
First-time visitors to the American West, couples, families and small groups.

WHO MAY PREFER ANOTHER TOUR
For the cities of the east, combine with New York and Washington.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION
Visitors to the United States need an ESTA or visa. Desert summers are very hot; spring and autumn are ideal.

days.name: Arrival in San Francisco
days.description:
What to expect: a private welcome.

Your driver meets you at the airport and takes you to your hotel. In the evening, walk to the waterfront or Union Square.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
Any time – Airport transfer.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Your guide calls to confirm the next day.

INCLUDED: airport transfer.
NOT INCLUDED: dinner.

Overnight: hotel in San Francisco.
Meals: none.

days.name: San Francisco: Alcatraz, cable cars and the Golden Gate
days.description:
What to expect: the city's landmarks.

Alcatraz, a cable car ride, Lombard Street, Chinatown, the Painted Ladies, the Golden Gate Bridge and the redwoods of Muir Woods.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
08:15 – Alcatraz.
11:30 – Cable car and Chinatown.
14:30 – Golden Gate Bridge.
15:30 – Muir Woods.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Bring a warm layer.

INCLUDED: vehicle, guide, tickets.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch.

Overnight: hotel in San Francisco.
Meals: breakfast.

days.name: Yosemite National Park
days.description:
What to expect: a day in Yosemite Valley.

A day trip to Yosemite: Tunnel View, Bridalveil Fall, El Capitan, a picnic by the Merced River and the walk to Yosemite Falls.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
06:00 – Departure.
10:00 – Tunnel View.
13:30 – Yosemite Falls.
20:30 – Back in San Francisco.

GOOD TO KNOW
• A long day; the valley is worth it.

INCLUDED: vehicle, guide, park entrance, lunch.
NOT INCLUDED: dinner.

Overnight: hotel in San Francisco.
Meals: breakfast, lunch.

days.name: Fly to Las Vegas
days.description:
What to expect: the desert city of lights.

You fly to Las Vegas, about 1 hour 30 minutes. In the evening, your guide shows you the Strip: the fountains of the Bellagio, the casinos and the lights of Fremont Street.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
Morning – Flight to Las Vegas.
19:00 – Evening on the Strip.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Shows can be booked in advance.

INCLUDED: transfers, flight, evening guide.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch, dinner.

Overnight: hotel in Las Vegas.
Meals: breakfast.

days.name: The Hoover Dam, Route 66 and sunset at the Grand Canyon
days.description:
What to expect: the road to the canyon.

You drive past the Hoover Dam and along Route 66 to the South Rim: Mather Point, the Rim Trail and sunset at Hopi Point. You sleep near the rim.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
08:00 – Departure.
08:45 – Hoover Dam.
11:30 – Route 66.
14:00 – South Rim.
Sunset – Hopi Point.

GOOD TO KNOW
• It is cooler at the rim.

INCLUDED: vehicle, guide, park entrance.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch, dinner.

Overnight: lodge at the Grand Canyon.
Meals: breakfast.

days.name: Sunrise at the Grand Canyon, Desert View and Horseshoe Bend
days.description:
What to expect: the canyon at dawn and the Colorado at sunset.

Sunrise over the canyon, the Desert View Watchtower, and the drive across the Navajo Nation to Page for sunset at Horseshoe Bend.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
Sunrise – Mather Point.
09:30 – Desert View.
13:00 – Page.
Sunset – Horseshoe Bend.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Bring water for the Horseshoe Bend trail.

INCLUDED: vehicle, guide.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch, dinner.

Overnight: hotel in Page.
Meals: breakfast.

days.name: Antelope Canyon and Monument Valley
days.description:
What to expect: a slot canyon and the buttes of the West.

A Navajo-guided tour of Antelope Canyon in the morning, then the drive to Monument Valley for a Navajo-guided tour among its red buttes and mesas at sunset.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
09:30 – Antelope Canyon.
12:00 – Drive to Monument Valley.
15:30 – Navajo-guided valley tour.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Bags are not allowed in Antelope Canyon.

INCLUDED: vehicle, guide, Navajo tours.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch, dinner.

Overnight: hotel in Monument Valley.
Meals: breakfast.

days.name: To Zion National Park
days.description:
What to expect: the drive to Zion.

Sunrise over Monument Valley, then the drive west to Zion National Park, about 4 hours, and an afternoon walk along the Virgin River on the Riverside Walk.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
Sunrise – Monument Valley.
09:00 – Drive to Zion.
14:00 – Zion Canyon and Riverside Walk.

GOOD TO KNOW
• The Zion Canyon shuttle runs most of the year.

INCLUDED: vehicle, guide, park entrance.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch, dinner.

Overnight: lodge near Zion.
Meals: breakfast.

A morning hike in Zion, such as the Emerald Pools or the Canyon Overlook trail, then the drive back to Las Vegas, about 2 hours 30 minutes.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)

12:00 – Lunch.
13:30 – Drive to Las Vegas.
16:30 – Hotel.

GOOD TO KNOW
• A farewell show can be booked.

INCLUDED: vehicle, guide.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch, dinner.

Overnight: hotel in Las Vegas.
Meals: breakfast.

After breakfast, your driver takes you to the airport for your onward flight.

INCLUDED: airport transfer.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch.

faq.question: How does booking on request work?
faq.answer: You choose a date and the number of travellers and send the request. Nothing is charged. We confirm availability, hotels and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay online only when the tour is confirmed.

faq.question: Is the flight included?
faq.answer: Yes, San Francisco to Las Vegas in economy with a checked bag.

faq.question: Do we need a visa?
faq.answer: Most visitors need an ESTA or a visa; check before travelling.

faq.question: What kind of hotels are used?
faq.answer: Comfortable 3- and 4-star hotels and lodges, chosen for location near the parks.

faq.question: Can we drive ourselves?
faq.answer: This is a private guided tour, but we can design a self-drive version on request.

faq.question: Is it suitable for children?
faq.answer: Yes. We book family rooms and adapt the walks.

faq.question: Is it suitable for people with limited mobility?
faq.answer: Largely. Most viewpoints are near parking; tell us your needs.

faq.question: Can we add Death Valley or Bryce Canyon?
How hot is it?
faq.answer: Las Vegas and Page exceed 40°C in summer; the Grand Canyon rim is much cooler.

faq.question: What should we wear?
faq.answer: Layers, comfortable walking shoes, a hat, sun cream and a warm jacket for the canyon rims.

faq.question: What is the best time of year?
faq.answer: April to June and September to October.

faq.question: Should we tip?
faq.answer: Tipping is customary in the United States: 15 to 20 percent is usual for guides and drivers if you were happy with the service, but it is always your choice.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour starts. Flights and Navajo tours are non-refundable once issued. Until your request is confirmed, nothing is charged at all.
